title: Nilisahau jina la bafu la umma, lakini jibu lilikuwa kwenye picha yangu
label: Bafu lililosahaulika

text.Near Morinomiya in Osaka, there is a pub: Karibu na Morinomiya mjini Osaka kuna bafu la umma maarufu katika eneo la Kansai.
Ni bafu la mtaa linalotumiwa na wakazi wa eneo hilo.
Lakini lina joto na hutuliza moyo.
text.It was a place that felt like \"this is: Palikuwa mahali palipohisi kama, “Hii ndiyo sento halisi ya Kijapani.”
text.I was going to write, \"People of Osaka,: Nilitaka kuandika, “Watu wa Osaka, tafadhali niambieni jina,” kisha nilipotazama tena picha yangu…
text.Pearl Onsen is an old-style public bath: Pearl Onsen ni bafu la jadi la umma lililochukuliwa na kampuni iitwayo Yutonami-sha mwaka 2024.
text.Yutonami-sha is a company famous in Kans: Yutonami-sha inajulikana Kansai kwa kuchukua na kuokoa mabafu ya umma yanayokaribia kufungwa.
text.I think this is why I remembered it as \: Nadhani ndiyo maana nililikumbuka kuwa “maarufu Kansai”.
